newsitem.title: UK: American Airlines chief issues BA merger warning.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines chief issues BA merger warning.

text.p: American Airlines chairman Robert Crandall has threatened to pull out of a proposed alliance with British Airways if Anglo- American talks on an "open skies" agreement dragged on much longer, the Guardian said.
Crandall was quoted by the paper as saying the talks would have to be finalised before the end of the year.
In London for a series of meetings with ministers and British Airways executives, he warned the government that if the "open skies" talks fail, American Airlines "will do a deal with somebody else."
Crandall made it clear that an open skies agreement was essential before the BA alliance could go ahead. He said both airlines would derive considerable benefit from the deal.
